  • Constructor Details

    • Prediction

      private Prediction(String liquidPhase, double gasDensityKgM3, double liquidDensityKgM3, double gasVelocityMs, double liquidVelocityMs, double relativeVelocityMs, double sauterMeanDiameterM, double residenceTimeS, double eotvosNumber, double weberNumber, String diameterLimiter)
      Creates one checked transfer-zone prediction.
      Parameters:
      liquidPhase - native liquid phase name
      gasDensityKgM3 - gas density in kg/m3
      liquidDensityKgM3 - liquid density in kg/m3
      gasVelocityMs - gas phase velocity in m/s
      liquidVelocityMs - liquid phase velocity in m/s
      relativeVelocityMs - gas-to-liquid relative speed in m/s
      sauterMeanDiameterM - conservative d32 proxy in m
      residenceTimeS - vertical bubble residence time in s
      eotvosNumber - Eotvos number at the selected diameter
      weberNumber - Weber number at the selected diameter
      diameterLimiter - stable active-limit code
